subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph shows the data of the number of accidents by three types of vehicles: X, Y and Z in four cities: P, Q, R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c02418fc0903f87e42af65265c90d397c231be4381bb2af74c288efaccbf93a.png] 

The maximum number of accidents in all cities are due to vehicles of type:
solution:
**Calculations:**

Total accidents for Vehicle Type X = Accidents in P (X) + Accidents in Q (X) + Accidents in R (X) + Accidents in S (X)

⇒ Total accidents for Vehicle Type X = 5 + 6 + 5 + 6 = 22

Total accidents for Vehicle Type Y = Accidents in P (Y) + Accidents in Q (Y) + Accidents in R (Y) + Accidents in S (Y)

⇒ Total accidents for Vehicle Type Y = 4 + 5 + 2 + 3 = 14

Total accidents for Vehicle Type Z = Accidents in P (Z) + Accidents in Q (Z) + Accidents in R (Z) + Accidents in S (Z)

⇒ Total accidents for Vehicle Type Z = 6 + 3 + 7 + 7 = 23

The maximum number of accidents is 23, which corresponds to Vehicle Type Z.

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
